case_number: 2024 INSC 71; CIVIL APPEAL NO(S). 1543 OF 2016, 1544 OF 2016
summary: Eviction disputes under Maharashtra Rent Control Act, 1999; municipal demolition notice grounds; bona fide requirement for reconstruction; Trial Court accepted commissioner report on dilapidated structure but rejected default/subletting claims; Appellate Court upheld eviction based on bona fide need and demolition necessity while reversing rent default finding; High Court Revisional Court set aside decrees holding Sections 15(3) and 16 requirements not satisfied; Supreme Court examined validity of eviction based on structural safety concerns and landlord's intended construction.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court judgment set aside; eviction decrees restored.
